defect: Independent WorkOnce formal invocations reuse the same .artifacts/tlc generated-module names and metadirs, so one invocation can truncate or replace a module while another TLC process parses it.

reproduction.diagnostic: TLC/SANY threw java.lang.NullPointerException while parsing the generated external sample mutant; the same global mutant path was subsequently rewritten by another active scripts/formal.mjs invocation in the same worktree.

requiredFix: Every lifecycle/storage/formal invocation must allocate a private generated-module/metadir workspace; formal runtime and non-runtime child shards must each receive distinct workspace paths. The normal assurance gate must bind and mutation-test that isolation.
